sessions.phase_label: Editorial scope confirmation, manuscript handoff, format resolution, and completion

requirements.title: Copyediting for Language Correctness
requirements.definition: Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and syntax in both manuscripts.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers mechanical language correctness only; readability revisions, style consistency, and the final proofreading pass are independently assessable obligations.

requirements.title: Readability, Clarity, and Author Voice
requirements.definition: Improve sentence flow, readability, and clarity while preserving the author's voice.
requirements.boundary_note: Flow, clarity, readability, and voice preservation form one tightly coupled line-editing objective; mechanical corrections and consistency checks remain separate.

requirements.title: Editorial and Style Consistency
requirements.definition: Maintain consistent wording, capitalization, textual formatting, and editorial style throughout both books.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers editorial consistency across the manuscripts. Message 33 indicates that conversion-related page-layout imperfections need not be corrected because professional book formatting will occur later.

requirements.title: Final Manuscript Proofreading
requirements.definition: Perform a final proofreading pass to eliminate remaining errors after editing.
requirements.boundary_note: The final proofreading pass is a distinct completion-stage obligation rather than another attribute of the initial copyedit.

requirements.title: U.S. English Standard
requirements.definition: Edit both books using U.S. English appropriate for the American KDP market.
requirements.boundary_note: The American KDP market establishes the language and localization standard but does not independently require KDP formatting or publication services.

requirements.title: Medical Fact-Checking Excluded
requirements.definition: Do not perform medical fact-checking because both books were already professionally medically reviewed.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently actionable editorial-scope constraint: the editor should improve presentation without reassessing medical accuracy.

requirements.title: Tracked and Clean Manuscript Copies
requirements.definition: Deliver one copy showing tracked edits and one clean copy of each manuscript.
requirements.boundary_note: The tracked and clean files are two complementary outputs of one manuscript-delivery mechanism rather than independent Requirements.

requirements.title: Editable Source Manuscript Format
requirements.definition: Provide the source manuscripts in a workable Microsoft Word or shared Google Docs format so editing can proceed; conversion-related layout imperfections are acceptable.
requirements.boundary_note: The editable file type and tolerance for conversion-related layout defects are coupled parts of resolving the manuscript handoff; professional page formatting is outside this editing task.

requirements.title: Project Completion Deadline
requirements.definition: Complete the editorial work by Monday, with the freelancer committing to completion by close of business Sunday.
requirements.boundary_note: The deadline is a standalone delivery constraint; the Sunday commitment is an earlier promised completion time within the client's Monday deadline.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client clearly excuses conversion-related formatting defects, but the evidence does not fully resolve whether all document-formatting consistency or only professional page-layout work is excluded from the current task.
